business_problem: The Center for BrainHealth needed to scale a longitudinal neuroscience study beyond manual, three-hour intake sessions and local high-touch processes without reducing participant engagement or scientific rigor.
solution_summary: The Center for BrainHealth partnered with Dialexa, an IBM Company, to create a digital participant platform for The BrainHealth Project. Dialexa used design research, interviews and workshops to define the user journey, then built a data platform and portal hosted on AWS Cloud that lets participants enroll remotely, complete assessments, consume digital offerings and receive personalized recommendations and reports. Machine-learning algorithms were developed with the center's statisticians to perform initial assessments and support The BrainHealth Index, while the broader platform tracks participant progress and manages the information exchange needed to keep people engaged over time. In practice, the solution replaces a location-bound manual intake model with a scalable digital operating layer for neuroscience research, pairing product engineering, data management and algorithmic assessment in one participant-friendly experience that supports both scientific analysis and future commercialization.

solution_components.name: Dialexa, an IBM Company
solution_components.role: Designed and engineered the digital product, participant portal and machine-learning assessment workflow for The BrainHealth Project.

solution_components.name: AWS Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the BrainHealth data platform and participant portal used for enrollment, assessments and personalized reports.

data_flow: Participants enroll remotely through the portal, complete digital assessments that feed the platform's data layer, machine-learning algorithms generate initial assessments and BrainHealth Index measures, and personalized recommendations and progress tracking are returned through the user portal.
business_outcome: The Center for BrainHealth dramatically reduced workload, expanded global reach and turned a local, manual research process into a scalable digital platform that now supports tens of thousands of participants.
